The value is collected from the user's image upload during profile updates and stored in the application's media storage system with a URL reference.

token.x-autobe-specification: Reference to IAuthorizationToken schema containing access and refresh JWT tokens. Tokens are generated by the authentication service upon successful login/join/refresh. Access token contains superAdmin ID, role, and expiration. Refresh token is stored in shopping_mall_super_admin_sessions with metadata. Server-side validation of token signature and expiration is required for each protected endpoint request.
token.description: JWT token information for authentication. Contains both access and refresh tokens required for subsequent authenticated requests to protected superAdmin endpoints.

IShoppingMallSuperAdmin.IAuthorized.description: Authentication response containing access and refresh tokens for superAdmin with user identification. This structure is returned after successful join, login, or refresh operations to enable subsequent authenticated requests to protected superAdmin endpoints. Contains the superAdmin's unique identifier and the authentication token pair.
IShoppingMallSuperAdmin.IAuthorized.x-autobe-specification: Authentication response DTO that represents a super administrator's authenticated session. Contains user identification (id, email) and authentication tokens (access and refresh) as referenced IAuthorizationToken. This schema does not map directly to any database table as it's a response object composed of claims from JWT tokens and user identity data extracted during authentication. The id and email properties are extracted from the JWT payload, while the token property contains the complete JWT token set generated by the authentication service.

refreshToken.description: Refresh token as a JWT string, used to renew access token for super administrator authentication without requiring re-authentication with email and password.
refreshToken.x-autobe-specification: JWT token string issued during login or join. The backend validates this token's signature, expiration, and existence in shopping_mall_super_admin_sessions table. Extracts superAdminId from token payload (claims) without needing additional ID field in request body. Token format follows standard JWT structure with header, payload (containing superAdminId, exp, iat), and signature.

IShoppingMallSuperAdmin.IRefresh.description: Request payload containing the refresh token used to renew a super administrator's access token. This token was originally issued during the superAdmin's login or registration (join) process. The refresh token is a signed JWT that allows the superAdmin to obtain a new access token without re-entering credentials.
IShoppingMallSuperAdmin.IRefresh.x-autobe-specification: The IShoppingMallSuperAdmin.IRefresh request body contains exactly one property: refreshToken, a signed JWT token issued during superAdmin login or registration. The backend extracts the superAdminId from the token's payload (claims) without requiring additional ID fields. The server validates the token's signature, expiration, and existence in the shopping_mall_super_admin_sessions table before issuing a new access token. No database field mapping is needed as the token is a self-contained JWT.

action.description: The action to take on the cancellation request - either 'approve' to grant the refund or 'reject' to deny it with an optional reason provided in the reason field. This field is required and must be one of the two specified values.
action.x-autobe-specification: This corresponds to cancellationRequest column in shopping_mall_cancellation_request_snapshots table, which contains the status transition value ('approve' or 'reject'). The value must be one of the two enum options, and triggers the corresponding business logic: approve initiates refund and restocks inventory; reject notifies customer and closes request.

reason.description: An optional human-readable explanation for rejecting a cancellation request. Provided only when 'action' is 'reject' to inform the customer why their request was denied. Ignored when action is 'approve'.
reason.x-autobe-specification: This property maps to description field in shopping_mall_cancellation_request_snapshots table when action is 'reject'. When action is 'approve', this field is ignored but the property must exist in the schema with the same contract to maintain type consistency for snapshot generation. Must be string with 500-character maximum.

IShoppingMallCancellationRequest.IRespon.description: Request body for responding to a cancellation request. Submit either 'approve' to grant the customer's refund request or 'reject' to deny it with an optional reason explanation.
IShoppingMallCancellationRequest.IRespon.x-autobe-specification: This DTO represents the request body for responding to cancellation requests. When action is 'approve', the system must: 1) Update status to 'approved' in shopping_mall_cancellation_requests table, 2) Trigger a refund process via shopping_mall_refund_requests, and 3) Restore inventory via shopping_mall_inventory_records. When action is 'reject', the system must: 1) Update status to 'rejected' in shopping_mall_cancellation_requests table, and 2) Record the reason in the cancellation_request_snapshots.description field. The cancellationRequest field in shopping_mall_cancellation_request_snapshots will be set based on the action value ('approve' or 'reject'). The reason field is optional and only included when action is 'reject'. Both actions create a snapshot in shopping_mall_cancellation_request_snapshots with actor ID and timestamp. The action must be one of 'approve' or 'reject' as per enum constraint.

IShoppingMallSeller.IUpdate.description: Partial update request for authenticated seller profile information. Allows sellers to modify their shopName (business name), shopDescription (display description), and logoImageUrl (profile image URL). These properties are displayed publicly but are stored in the linked user entity, not directly in shopping_mall_sellers. Administrative fields (approvalStatus, isSuspended, etc.) are excluded as they can only be modified by administrators through dedicated endpoints.
IShoppingMallSeller.IUpdate.x-autobe-specification: Partial update schema for seller profile. Maps indirectly to user entity via user_id relation in shopping_mall_sellers. Fields shopName, shopDescription, logoImageUrl are not stored in shopping_mall_sellers table but are derived from the linked user entity (users table). Application layer handles this mapping during update: updates to shopName, shopDescription, logoImageUrl are propagated to corresponding fields in the users table via the user_id reference. All fields are optional in request and trigger a profile snapshot update in shopping_mall_seller_profile_snapshots.

pending.description: Number of shipments in 'pending' status, representing orders that have been paid but not yet shipped by the seller.
pending.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregate. COUNT of shopping_mall_shipments records where status is 'pending' and shipment is linked to seller's order items via shopping_mall_shipment_items junction table.

shipped.description: Number of shipments in 'shipped' status, representing orders that have been dispatched by the seller with tracking information recorded.
shipped.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregate. COUNT of shopping_mall_shipments records where status is 'shipped' and linked to seller's order items.

delivered.description: Number of shipments in 'delivered' status, representing orders where the customer has confirmed receipt.
delivered.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregate. COUNT of shopping_mall_shipments records where status is 'delivered' and linked to seller's order items via delivery confirmations.

canceled.description: Number of shipments that were canceled prior to being shipped, representing orders where the customer requested cancellation and it was approved.
canceled.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregate. COUNT of shopping_mall_shipments records where orders were canceled before shipment, respecting the cancellation-request caching logic.

IShoppingMallShipment.description: Dashboard summary of shipment status counts for the authenticated seller. Provides aggregated counts of shipments across four status categories: pending, shipped, delivered, and canceled. This helps sellers monitor their fulfillment workflow by providing immediate visibility into order processing progress across their entire inventory. The dashboard shows totals for each status category but does not expose individual shipment records or customer details, maintaining data privacy and performance optimization for dashboard queries.
IShoppingMallShipment.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregate type representing shipment status distribution. Data sources: JOIN of shopping_mall_shipments and shopping_mall_order_items tables. Grouped by shipment status with COUNT aggregation. Calculates total shipments per status: pending, shipped, delivered, canceled. Returns 0 if no shipments exist in a particular status. No joins to other tables required. Business rule: Only count shipments associated with the authenticated seller's products.

currency.description: The primary currency code used throughout the platform, following ISO 4217 standard (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY). All monetary values displayed to users are rendered in this base currency, and pricing is calculated relative to this currency.
currency.x-autobe-specification: This value is stored as a JSON field within the 'config' column of the shopping_mall_configurations table. Must be a valid ISO 4217 3-character currency code (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'JPY'). Application-layer validation ensures the format is correct before the entire configuration JSON object is serialized to the database. No conversion or normalization is performed; the value is stored exactly as provided.

timezone.description: The default timezone for the entire platform, specified using IANA timezone database format (e.g., 'America/New_York'). All dates and times displayed to users follow this timezone, while internal system operations use UTC for consistency.
timezone.x-autobe-specification: This value is stored as a JSON field within the 'config' column of the shopping_mall_configurations table. Must be a valid IANA timezone identifier (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Asia/Tokyo', 'Europe/London'). Application-layer validation ensures the format is correct before the entire configuration JSON object is serialized to the database. All timestamps in the system are stored and processed in UTC, but this setting determines the default timezone for displaying times to users.

locale.description: The default locale for the entire platform, specified in BCP 47 format (e.g., 'en-US'). This determines default language, date formatting (MM/DD/YYYY vs DD/MM/YYYY), number formatting (1,000.00 vs 1.000,00), currency display, and other regional conventions for all users.
locale.x-autobe-specification: This value is stored as a JSON field within the 'config' column of the shopping_mall_configurations table. Must be a valid BCP 47 language-country format (e.g., 'en-US', 'ja-JP', 'fr-FR'). Application-layer validation ensures the format is correct before the entire configuration JSON object is serialized to the database. This setting controls default language, date formats, number formatting, and other cultural conventions for users across the platform.

payment_gateway.description: The primary payment processor used by the platform for all financial transactions. Must be one of the supported providers: 'stripe', 'paypal', 'razorpay', or 'square'. This setting controls which payment gateway API integration is active throughout the entire platform.
payment_gateway.x-autobe-specification: This value is stored as a JSON field within the 'config' column of the shopping_mall_configurations table. Must be one of the exact enum values: 'stripe', 'paypal', 'razorpay', or 'square'. Application-layer validation ensures the value exactly matches one of the supported providers before the entire configuration JSON object is serialized to the database. Backend systems use this value to route payments to the corresponding payment gateway API.

tax_calculation.description: The tax calculation method used for all transactions across the platform. Options are 'standard' (tax calculated on top of base price), 'reverse' (tax deducted from total price), or 'exempt' (no tax applied). This setting globally controls how sales tax is calculated for all customers.
tax_calculation.x-autobe-specification: This value is stored as a JSON field within the 'config' column of the shopping_mall_configurations table. Must be one of the exact enum values: 'standard', 'reverse', or 'exempt'. Application-layer validation ensures the value exactly matches one of the three options before the entire configuration JSON object is serialized to the database. This setting determines the tax calculation method used across the platform: 'standard' calculates tax on top of base price, 'reverse' deducts tax from total, and 'exempt' applies no tax.

shipping_rate_strategy.description: The default shipping cost calculation method used for all sellers on the platform. Options include 'flat' (fixed rate), 'weight_based' (calculated by item weight), 'free_threshold' (free when order exceeds minimum value), or 'tiered' (different rates for different order value ranges). This setting provides the baseline shipping logic for all sellers.
shipping_rate_strategy.x-autobe-specification: This value is stored as a JSON field within the 'config' column of the shopping_mall_configurations table. Must be one of the exact enum values: 'flat', 'weight_based', 'free_threshold', or 'tiered'. Application-layer validation ensures the value exactly matches one of the four options before the entire configuration JSON object is serialized to the database. This setting determines the default shipping cost calculation method: 'flat' applies fixed rate, 'weight_based' calculates by item weight, 'free_threshold' offers free shipping above a minimum order value, and 'tiered' uses multiple pricing tiers based on order value.

feature_toggles.description: A set of boolean flags that enable or disable key platform features globally. Includes: allow_seller_registration (can new sellers join?), require_email_verification (must users verify email?), enable_product_reviews (can customers write reviews?), auto_approve_sellers (are sellers approved automatically?), allow_guest_checkout (can users checkout without account?), use_dynamic_pricing (can prices change dynamically?), enable_live_chat (is chat support available?), and allow_bulk_product_import (can sellers import products in bulk?). Changes affect all users immediately.
feature_toggles.x-autobe-specification: This value is stored as a JSON field within the 'config' column of the shopping_mall_configurations table. Contains a JSON object with boolean values for each feature flag: allow_seller_registration, require_email_verification, enable_product_reviews, auto_approve_sellers, allow_guest_checkout, use_dynamic_pricing, enable_live_chat, and allow_bulk_product_import. Each boolean value determines whether a corresponding platform feature is enabled or disabled globally. Application-layer validation ensures all keys exist and values are boolean before the entire configuration JSON object is serialized to the database. Changes to feature toggles take effect immediately and affect all users on the platform.

created_at.description: The timestamp when this configuration record was first created in the database, represented in UTC ISO 8601 format. This is a system-managed read-only field that provides traceability for when the configuration was initially established.
created_at.x-autobe-specification: This value is stored as a JSON field within the 'config' column of the shopping_mall_configurations table. Contains the UTC timestamp (ISO 8601 format) when this configuration record was first created in the database. This is a system-managed field automatically populated by the database and cannot be modified through API requests. Used for audit trail and system integrity verification. The JSON field value is managed by the application layer, which sets it based on the database-created_at value.

updated_at.description: The timestamp (in UTC ISO 8601 format) indicating when this configuration record was last updated. This is automatically maintained by the system and used to invalidate cached configuration data. All configuration changes trigger an automatic update to this timestamp.
updated_at.x-autobe-specification: This value is stored as a JSON field within the 'config' column of the shopping_mall_configurations table. Contains the UTC timestamp (ISO 8601 format) when this configuration record was last modified. This is a system-managed field automatically updated by the application layer each time the configuration is changed. Used for tracking when the last configuration update occurred and for cache invalidation. The JSON field value is managed by the application layer, which updates it based on database-updated_at value.

IShoppingMallConfiguration.description: Global configuration settings for the shopping mall platform that control system-wide behavior across all user roles. This includes core platform parameters such as currency code, timezone, locale, payment gateway configurations, tax calculation rules, shipping rate strategies, and feature toggles that modify platform functionality. All configuration values are stored as a single authoritative record in the database, ensuring consistent application across the entire platform. Changes to these settings have immediate and uniform effects on customer experience, seller operations, and administrative workflows. The configuration system is designed for centralized control, where updates are logged through an audit trail and preserved through snapshots for compliance and historical reference. Any configuration setting that is not explicitly provided in an update operation retains its previous value, ensuring comprehensive coverage of all platform parameters.
IShoppingMallConfiguration.x-autobe-specification: Configuration values are stored as a single JSON object in the 'config' column of the shopping_mall_configurations table. All properties are JSON fields within this object, not individual database columns. The 'id' column serves as the primary key to identify the single configuration record. Application-layer validation ensures all values conform to specified formats: currency follows ISO 4217 standard (3-character code), timezone uses IANA format, locale uses BCP 47 format, and each enum field uses exact values from defined sets. The feature_toggles object contains boolean flags representing platform features. All timestamp fields (created_at, updated_at) are stored as UTC ISO 8601 strings. No data transformation occurs in the database; all validation and formatting is performed at the application layer before the JSON object is serialized to the config column and deserialized when retrieved.

shippingAddressId.description: Unique identifier of the customer's shipping address to be used for this order. Must reference an existing address in the customer's address book.
shippingAddressId.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_orders.shipping_address_id column. UUID reference to customer's address in shopping_mall_addresses table. Used to determine shipping location for order fulfillment.

paymentMethodToken.description: Payment authorization token received from the external payment gateway (e.g., Stripe, PayPal). This token represents verified customer payment authorization and will be exchanged for a payment transaction by the backend system.
paymentMethodToken.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from external payment gateway token provided by frontend. This token represents payment authorization from Stripe, PayPal, or other payment provider. It is validated by the backend payment service and used to create a payment transaction. The actual payment amount and currency are derived from the cart contents and not included here.

IShoppingMallOrder.ICreate.description: Request DTO for creating a new order from a customer's shopping cart. Contains the required fields for order placement: the shipping address identifier and the payment token from the external payment gateway. This schema defines the minimal information needed to initiate order creation during checkout. The customer identity is securely provided through authentication context (JWT), eliminating the need to include customer identifiers in the request. The shipping address reference points to an existing address in the customer's address book, and the payment token represents authorization from the payment gateway. This design ensures data security, prevents tampering with customer identity, and supports audit trails through system-generated identifiers.
IShoppingMallOrder.ICreate.x-autobe-specification: Create DTO for shopping_mall_orders table. Maps to: shippingAddressId from shopping_mall_orders.shipping_address_id column. paymentMethodToken maps directly to the external payment gateway token provided by frontend. The orderNumber is generated by system and not included here. The total amount is calculated from cart items and stored in the order record but not provided in request. The customer identifier is inferred from JWT authentication context and not included in request body. The payment status is set to 'pending' by system after validation and not included in request. No other fields are provided in request; all others are auto-generated on creation.

value.description: A JWT refresh token used to obtain a new access token without requiring re-authentication with email and password. This token is stored securely in the shopping_mall_seller_sessions table and is used exclusively for the refresh endpoint to maintain session continuity. The token must be submitted in the request body when calling POST /shoppingMall/auth/seller/refresh.
value.x-autobe-specification: This is a JWT refresh token string. It is stored in the shopping_mall_seller_sessions table for the authenticated seller. When presented in the refresh endpoint, the server validates this token against the session record, checks its expiration, and if valid, generates a new access token and refresh token while invalidating the old one. The token is a base64-encoded JWT containing claims for seller identity and expiration time.

IShoppingMallSeller.IRefresh.description: A JWT refresh token used to obtain a new access token without requiring re-authentication with email and password. This token is stored securely in the shopping_mall_seller_sessions table and is used exclusively for the refresh endpoint to maintain session continuity. The token must be submitted in the request body when calling POST /shoppingMall/auth/seller/refresh.
IShoppingMallSeller.IRefresh.x-autobe-specification: This is a JWT refresh token object used for authentication token renewal in the seller authentication system. The token is a string value that represents a persistent session for sellers, stored in the shopping_mall_seller_sessions table. When presented in the POST /shoppingMall/auth/seller/refresh endpoint, the server validates the token against the session record, checks its expiration, and if valid, issues a new access token and refresh token while invalidating the old one to enhance security through token rotation. The token should not be stored client-side as plaintext but as a secure HTTP-only cookie or encrypted storage.

IShoppingMallAdmin.description: Comprehensive administrative dashboard statistics providing an overview of shoppingMall platform performance and operational health. Includes key performance indicators for seller management, product catalog, order fulfillment, and system health to support strategic decision-making by administrators.
IShoppingMallAdmin.x-autobe-specification: Comprehensive administrative dashboard metrics calculated by aggregating data from multiple domain tables: seller metrics from shopping_mall_sellers (count total, pending, approved, suspended, rejected, banned); product metrics from shopping_mall_products (count total, active, inactive, out_of_stock variants, products with zero variants); order metrics from shopping_mall_orders (count total, paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled, refunded); system metrics from shopping_mall_customers, shopping_mall_cancellation_requests, shopping_mall_refund_requests, shopping_mall_customer_sessions (count total customers, pending cancellations, pending refunds, active sessions, system uptime hours); derived metrics: average_order_value (sum of paid order totals / count of paid orders), seller_approval_rate (count approved sellers / count total sellers), customer_retention_rate (count returning customers / count total customers). This is a computed/aggregated type with no direct database table mapping. All calculations are real-time queries against transactional data with 30-second caching. Fallback behavior returns available metrics with status flags if data sources are temporarily unavailable.

reason.description: Reason for requesting cancellation of the order item. Must be at least 10 characters long and provide a clear explanation to the seller regarding why the cancellation is being requested. This text is shown to the seller in the cancellation request review interface to help them make an informed decision on approving or rejecting the request.
reason.x-autobe-specification: This request DTO captures the cancellation reason for an order item. The value must be a string with minimum 10 characters, as specified in the API operation description. The reason field is used to provide context to the seller for approving or rejecting the cancellation request, as per the business logic in the cancellation workflow documentation. This is a pure request type - no database persistence; the actual cancellation request record with its ID and status is created by the system, not provided in the request body.

IShoppingMallCancellationRequest.IReques.description: Reason for requesting cancellation of the order item. Must be at least 10 characters long and provide a clear explanation to the seller regarding why the cancellation is being requested. This text is shown to the seller in the cancellation request review interface to help them make an informed decision on approving or rejecting the request.
IShoppingMallCancellationRequest.IReques.x-autobe-specification: This request DTO captures the cancellation reason for an order item. The value must be a string with minimum 10 characters, as specified in the API operation description. The reason field is used to provide context to the seller for approving or rejecting the cancellation request, as per the business logic in the cancellation workflow documentation. This is a pure request type - no database persistence; the actual cancellation request record with its ID and status is created by the system, not provided in the request body.

sellerId.description: Unique identifier for the seller account used for reference in administrative workflows.
sellerId.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_sellers.id column. This is the primary key for the seller entity.

IShoppingMallSeller.ISummary.description: A lightweight summary of a seller account for administrative oversight. Contains essential identification and status information for evaluation purposes, excluding sensitive and operational fields that are unnecessary in summary context. Used in administrative interfaces such as the seller approval workflow.
IShoppingMallSeller.ISummary.x-autobe-specification: Lightweight summary representation of a seller for administrative interfaces. Excludes sensitive fields (email, password, logoImageUrl) to minimize exposure while providing essential identification and status information for approval workflows. This schema does not map directly to column-level fields in shopping_mall_sellers table. Instead, all properties are derived through joins with the user table and user profile snapshots to provide a complete administrative view.

totalAbandonedCarts.description: The total count of shopping carts that were created by customers but never converted into completed orders within the abandonment window period.
totalAbandonedCarts.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. COUNT of cart items with no associated order_id within abandonment window (24-48 hours). Represents the total number of shopping carts created but never converted to orders.

averageCartValue.description: The average monetary value (in base currency) of all abandoned shopping carts that were created but never converted into completed orders within the abandonment window period.
averageCartValue.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. AVG of cart_item.quantity * unit_price for abandoned carts (those with no associated order_id within abandonment window). Represents the average monetary value of abandoned carts.

abandonmentRate.description: The percentage of shopping carts that were abandoned (created but not converted to orders) out of all carts created within the abandonment window period, expressed as a decimal ratio between 0 and 1.
abandonmentRate.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. (totalAbandonedCarts / totalCartsInWindow) * 1.0, where totalCartsInWindow is the total count of cart items created within the abandonment window period. The result is expressed as a ratio from 0 to 1.

averageTimeToAbandonment.description: The average number of hours elapsed between the time a shopping cart was created and when it was determined to be abandoned (no associated completed order).
averageTimeToAbandonment.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. AVG of (current_time - cart_created_at) in hours for abandoned carts (those with no associated order_id within abandonment window). Measures average duration between cart creation and abandonment.

IShoppingMallCartItem.description: Analytics summary of shopping cart abandonment statistics. Contains aggregated metrics on how many carts were abandoned (created but not converted to orders), their average monetary value, the rate of abandonment as a percentage, and the average time elapsed between cart creation and abandonment. Used to identify friction points in the purchase funnel and optimize conversion rates.
IShoppingMallCartItem.x-autobe-specification: This is a computed type with no direct database mapping. Values are calculated from shopping_mall_cart_items table: totalAbandonedCarts = COUNT of cart items with no associated order_id within abandonment window (24-48 hours). averageCartValue = AVG of cart_item.quantity * unit_price for those abandoned carts. abandonmentRate = (totalAbandonedCarts / totalCartsInWindow) * 1.0. averageTimeToAbandonment = AVG of (current_time - cart_created_at) in hours for those abandoned carts. All values are computed from aggregation queries on the cart_items table, not from any single row.

success.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the review report was successfully submitted. true means the system recorded the report; false indicates a system failure. This field exists only to confirm client-side action processing, not to convey any additional information.
success.x-autobe-specification: Direct boolean flag indicating successful report submission. Determined by successful insertion of record into shopping_mall_review_reports table. No additional data or server-generated IDs are included in response for security and simplicity.

IShoppingMallReviewReport.IResponse.description: Confirmation response for successful review report submission. This object indicates that the review has been successfully reported to administrators for moderation. This is a lightweight response type intended for client-side UI confirmation — it does not contain report details, internal IDs, or timestamps. Only a boolean flag confirms successful processing. For security and simplicity, no additional information is returned to the frontend client, as this interface is designed solely for action confirmation, not data retrieval.
IShoppingMallReviewReport.IResponse.x-autobe-specification: Response type for review report submission. Indicates successful confirmation of report creation. No data is returned beyond the boolean success flag because the client only needs confirmation that the action was processed. The actual report record is stored in shopping_mall_review_reports table, but its details are not returned to the client for security and simplicity. This response is used after successful PATCH /shoppingMall/admin/reviews/report. This response type does not map to any database table as it is a pure success acknowledgment type.

healthScore.description: Overall inventory health score on a scale of 0-100, representing system stability, responsiveness, and reliability. Higher scores indicate better inventory management with adequate supply, timely restocking, minimal stockouts, and accurate adjustments.
healthScore.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. Derived from: (currentStockScore * 0.4) + (restockEventScore * 0.3) + (outOfStockScore * 0.2) + (adjustmentAccuracyScore * 0.1). All component scores normalized to 0-100 using min-max scaling on 30-day historical data.

currentStock.description: Total current stock level across all product variants, calculated by summing all inventory adjustments (positive and negative). This value reflects real-time inventory availability.
currentStock.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. SUM of quantityChange from shopping_mall_inventory_records for each variant, grouped by variantId, excluding records marked as deleted. Represents absolute current stock level across all variants.

restockEvents.description: Number of restocking events observed in the past 30 days. Tracks frequency of inventory replenishment activities including supplier deliveries, returns received, manual adjustments, and damaged goods replacements.
restockEvents.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. COUNT of records in shopping_mall_inventory_records where reason IN ('Supplier Delivery', 'Returns Received', 'Manual Adjustment', 'Damaged Goods Replacement') and createdAt >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'. Counts restocking events within past 30 days.

outOfStockCount.description: Number of product variants that currently have zero or negative stock. This indicates out-of-stock conditions and potential inventory shortages affecting product availability.
outOfStockCount.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. COUNT of distinct variantId from shopping_mall_inventory_records where SUM(quantityChange) <= 0. Counts variants with zero or negative current stock levels.

adjustmentAccuracy.description: Percentage of inventory adjustments that have specific, meaningful reasons instead of generic 'Other' classifications. Higher values indicate better tracking and accountability in inventory management practices.
adjustmentAccuracy.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. (COUNT of records where reason != 'Other') / (COUNT of all records in shopping_mall_inventory_records) * 100. Measures percentage of inventory adjustments with specific reasons rather than generic 'Other'.

currentStockScore.description: Normalized score (0-100) representing current stock levels. This component contributes 40% to the overall health score and measures inventory adequacy - higher scores indicate adequate supply and lower risk of stockouts.
currentStockScore.x-autobe-specification: Computed score. Normalized linear scale from 0-100 based on currentStock value compared to 30-day historical data range. Higher currentStock values yield higher scores, indicating better inventory adequacy.

restockEventScore.description: Normalized score (0-100) representing restock frequency over the past 30 days. This component contributes 30% to the overall health score and measures system responsiveness - higher scores indicate prompt inventory replenishment.
restockEventScore.x-autobe-specification: Computed score. Normalized linear scale from 0-100 based on restockEvents count compared to 30-day historical data range. Higher restockEvents count yields higher score, indicating timely replenishment.

outOfStockScore.description: Normalized score (0-100) representing product availability. This component contributes 20% to the overall health score and measures stockout prevention - higher scores indicate fewer out-of-stock items and better inventory control.
outOfStockScore.x-autobe-specification: Computed score. Normalized linear scale from 0-100 based on outOfStockCount compared to 30-day historical data range. Lower outOfStockCount values yield higher scores, indicating better product availability.

totalAdjustments.description: Total number of inventory adjustments recorded across all product variants. This metric indicates the volume and activity of inventory operations in the system.

IShoppingMallInventoryHealth.description:
Composite inventory health score and supporting metrics for system monitoring and operational improvement. This metric aggregates data from the inventory_records table to measure stability, responsiveness, and reliability of inventory operations across all product variants. The calculation combines four weighted factors: current stock levels (40% weight) to evaluate inventory adequacy and avoid both shortage and overstocking, restock frequency (30% weight) to measure how quickly inventory is replenished after depletion, out-of-stock occurrences (20% weight) to track product availability performance, and adjustment accuracy (10% weight) to assess the precision of inventory adjustments. A high score indicates an inventory system that is well-managed with adequate supply, timely restocking, minimal stockouts, and reliable adjustment practices. A low score signals potential problems such as inventory mismanagement, delayed restocking, or excessive manual adjustments, prompting operational interventions.

The health score is computed from actual inventory transaction data, not from snapshots, ensuring it reflects real-time conditions. The system calculates current stock by summing all quantityChange values for each variant, ignoring records marked as deleted. Restock frequency is measured by counting records with approved restock reasons within the past 30 days. Out-of-stock count tallies the number of distinct variants that currently have zero or negative stock. Adjustment accuracy quantifies the proportion of inventory adjustments that provide specific reasons rather than generic 'Other' classifications.

This metric is designed to be consumed by inventory management dashboards and alerting systems. Related operations include retrieving inventory history by variant (GET /inventory/{variantId}/history) and managing inventory adjustments (POST /inventory/add and POST /inventory/subtract).
IShoppingMallInventoryHealth.x-autobe-specification: Computed result type. Data sourced from shopping_mall_inventory_records. currentStock: SUM of quantityChange for each variant, grouped by variantId, excluding deleted records. restockEvents: COUNT of records where reason IN ('Supplier Delivery', 'Returns Received', 'Manual Adjustment', 'Damaged Goods Replacement') and createdAt >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'. outOfStockCount: COUNT of distinct variantId with SUM(quantityChange) <= 0. adjustmentAccuracy: (COUNT of records where reason != 'Other') / (COUNT of all records) * 100. healthScore: (currentStockScore * 0.4) + (restockEventScore * 0.3) + (outOfStockScore * 0.2) + (adjustmentAccuracyScore * 0.1), where each component score is a linear scale from 0-100 based on normalized thresholds. All scores normalized to 0-100 range using min-max scaling on 30-day historical data.

totalVariants.description: Total count of unique product variants currently in inventory across the entire platform. Represents the diversity of products available for sale.
totalVariants.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation from inventory_records. COUNT(DISTINCT variant_id) to determine number of unique product variants in stock. Excludes variants with zero or negative quantity.

totalInventoryValue.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation from inventory_records and product variants: SUM(quantity * variant_price) to determine total monetary value of inventory. Uses variant_price (which may override base_price) for accurate valuation. Returns 0 if no inventory records exist.

IShoppingMallInventoryStatistic.description: Aggregated inventory statistics for the entire shopping mall platform. Represents a computed summary of inventory health across all variants, including total number of distinct variants in stock, total quantity across all variants, average price per variant, and total inventory value based on variant pricing. Used in administrative dashboards to understand overall inventory levels and make strategic restocking decisions. Values are calculated dynamically by joining inventory records with product variant pricing information and should not be modified manually.
IShoppingMallInventoryStatistic.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation type. Data sourced from shopping_mall_inventory_records table joined with product variants to obtain unit prices. totalVariants: COUNT(DISTINCT variant_id) from inventory_records. totalQuantity: SUM(quantity) from inventory_records. averagePrice: SUM(quantity * variant_price) / SUM(quantity) from inventory_records joined with variant prices. totalInventoryValue: SUM(quantity * variant_price) from inventory_records joined with variant prices. Handle cases where inventory_records is empty by returning zeros for all values. Return null prices as zero in calculations to avoid NaN. Cache results for 5 minutes with platform-wide cache key to optimize performance.

IShoppingMallConfiguration.ICreate.description: Request DTO for creating or updating configuration settings in the shopping_mall_configurations table. This type allows administrators to modify system-wide configuration parameters that control platform behavior including payment gateway settings, shipping methods, default categories, notification templates, and other operational settings. The configuration key-value pairs in this request body are dynamically mapped to columns in the shopping_mall_configurations table. Any configuration key that doesn't exist will be created, and any existing key will be updated with the provided value. Values must be of type string, number, or boolean, and will be stored as JSON-encoded values in the database. This flexible approach allows the platform to evolve its configuration requirements without requiring schema changes to the API.
IShoppingMallConfiguration.ICreate.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from configuration key-value pairs. Each property in this request body maps directly to a column in the shopping_mall_configurations table. The table contains at least the following columns: key (string primary key), value (JSON string), created_at (datetime), and updated_at (datetime). The request body accepts any key as property name, with value as one of: string, number, or boolean. Values must be compatible with the table's value column, which stores JSON-encoded values. For boolean values, the schema allows true/false, which will be serialized to boolean type in the database. For numeric values, the schema allows integers and decimals, which will be stored as numbers. For string values, the schema accepts plain strings, which will be stored as JSON strings. No type conversion is performed in the backend - the values provided must match the expected type for the configuration key.

IShoppingMallRefundRequest.IUpdate.description:
Update request for a refund request that allows authorized actors (seller or admin) to either approve the refund (restoring inventory) or reject the request with a reason.

This DTO is used in administrative operations where the decision-maker approves the refund request (which restores inventory to the product variant) or rejects it with an explanation for the customer. The authentication context identifies the actor (seller or admin) through their JWT token, so no actor identification fields are included in the request body.

When status is 'approve', the system automatically restores the product variant's inventory quantity, processes the refund through the payment gateway, and generates an audit trail.

When status is 'reject', the system sends a notification to the customer with the provided reason, maintains the current order state, and creates an audit trail of the rejection decision. The reason field must clearly explain why the refund was denied.
IShoppingMallRefundRequest.IUpdate.x-autobe-specification: Request DTO for updating refund request status. status field maps to refund_status column and must be either 'approve' or 'reject'. reason field maps to rejection_reason column and is only required when status is 'reject'. No other fields are included as they are either system-managed or not user-modifiable in request context.

IShoppingMallOrder.description:
Complete order entity that represents a customer's purchase transaction. Contains all fundamental information about the order including its metadata, detailed breakdown of ordered items with historical snapshots of product variants and shipping details, and tracking information for all shipments associated with this order. This entity provides a full historical record of the transaction that remains immutable even if sellers update their products, prices, or shop information after the order is placed.

The order entity is the central record for customer support, dispute resolution, financial reconciliation, and compliance auditing. It integrates data from multiple systems: the order system (order metadata), the inventory system (variant information), the product catalog (product details), the seller profiles (shop information), and the shipping system (tracking details). Each order item maintains a snapshot of the product, variant, and seller data exactly as it was at the time of purchase, ensuring that historical accuracy is preserved for all future reference.

The order's status is derived from the combination of the status of its individual order items and associated shipment confirmations. This allows for complex order scenarios where some items may be delivered while others are canceled or refunded. The order remains active (unpaid, processing, etc.) until all items reach their final state. The total price reflects the sum of each item's quantity multiplied by the unit price captured at order time, ensuring accurate financial records regardless of future price changes.

All customer information such as shipping address is captured as it was at the time of order placement, ensuring consistent communication and fulfillment. This complete order representation enables customers, sellers, and administrators to review past transactions with full context, including what was ordered, at what price, from which seller, and how it was shipped.
IShoppingMallOrder.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_orders table. orderNumber format: 'ORD-YYYYMMDD-####'. totalPrice: sum of order_item.quantity * order_item.price. status: derived from aggregation of individual order_item statuses and shipment delivery status. customerId: extracted from session context during creation, stored in shopping_mall_orders.customer_id column. shippingAddress: joined from shopping_mall_addresses table using address_id. orderItems: array populated by JOIN with shopping_mall_order_items, and for each item, snapshot data retrieved from shopping_mall_order_item_snapshots and shopping_mall_sale_specifications tables. shipments: array built from JOIN with shopping_mall_shipments via junction table shopping_mall_shipment_items which links order items to shipments. All snapshot fields (product name/description/images, variant options/price, seller shop name/logo) are captured at time of order creation from the respective tables, as required by snapshot principle (14-snapshot-principle.md).

totalSellers.description: Total number of seller accounts registered on the platform, excluding banned accounts.
totalSellers.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopping_mall_sellers WHERE isBanned = false. Includes all sellers regardless of approval status.

pendingSellers.description: Number of seller accounts currently awaiting approval by administrators.
pendingSellers.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopping_mall_sellers WHERE approvalStatus = 'pending'. Counts sellers awaiting administrator approval.

approvedSellers.description: Number of seller accounts that have been approved and are currently active (not suspended or banned).
approvedSellers.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopping_mall_sellers WHERE approvalStatus = 'approved' AND isSuspended = false AND isBanned = false. Counts active approved sellers.

suspendedSellers.description: Number of seller accounts that have been temporarily suspended by administrators for policy violations.
suspendedSellers.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopping_mall_sellers WHERE isSuspended = true AND isBanned = false. Counts sellers temporarily suspended by administrators.

rejectedSellers.description: Number of seller applications that were rejected by administrators during the approval process.
rejectedSellers.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopping_mall_sellers WHERE approvalStatus = 'rejected'. Counts seller applications that were rejected by administrators.

bannedSellers.description: Number of seller accounts that have been permanently banned from the platform due to severe policy violations.
bannedSellers.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopping_mall_sellers WHERE isBanned = true. Counts sellers permanently banned from the platform.

totalProducts.description: Total number of active product listings on the platform, excluding deleted products.
totalProducts.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopping_mall_products WHERE isDeleted = false. Counts all non-deleted products across all sellers.

activeProducts.description: Number of products that have at least one variant currently in stock and available for purchase.
activeProducts.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopping_mall_products WHERE isDeleted = false AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shopping_mall_product_variants WHERE productId = shopping_mall_products.id AND isDeleted = false AND stockQuantity > 0). Counts products with at least one variant in stock.

inactiveProducts.description: Number of products that exist but have no variants currently available in stock (all variants are out of stock or deleted).
inactiveProducts.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopping_mall_products WHERE isDeleted = false AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shopping_mall_product_variants WHERE productId = shopping_mall_products.id AND isDeleted = false AND stockQuantity > 0). Counts products with no variants in stock or all variants deleted.

outOfStockVariants.description: Total number of product variants (SKUs) that are currently out of stock, regardless of product status.
outOfStockVariants.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopping_mall_product_variants WHERE isDeleted = false AND stockQuantity = 0. Counts all product variants (SKUs) that are currently out of stock.

productsWithZeroVariants.description: Number of product listings that have no variants defined (zero SKUs), making them non-purchasable.
productsWithZeroVariants.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopping_mall_products WHERE isDeleted = false AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shopping_mall_product_variants WHERE productId = shopping_mall_products.id AND isDeleted = false). Counts products with no variants defined at all.

totalOrders.description: Total number of orders placed on the platform since its inception.
totalOrders.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopping_mall_orders. Counts all orders created on the platform regardless of status.

paidOrders.description: Number of orders that have been successfully paid for by customers.
paidOrders.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopping_mall_orders WHERE paymentStatus = 'paid'. Counts orders where payment has been successfully processed.

shippedOrders.description: Number of orders that have been packed and shipped by sellers (at least one shipment has been created).
shippedOrders.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopping_mall_orders WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shopping_mall_shipments WHERE shopping_mall_shipments.orderId = shopping_mall_orders.id). Counts orders with at least one shipment created.

deliveredOrders.description: Number of orders where all items have been marked as delivered by customers.
deliveredOrders.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopping_mall_orders WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shopping_mall_shipments WHERE shopping_mall_shipments.orderId = shopping_mall_orders.id AND is_delivered = true). Counts orders with all shipments marked as delivered.

cancelledOrders.description: Number of orders that have been fully cancelled and are no longer active.
cancelledOrders.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopping_mall_orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'. Counts orders that have been fully cancelled by customers or administrators.

refundedOrders.description: Number of orders that have been approved for refund, either partially or fully.
refundedOrders.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopping_mall_orders WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shopping_mall_refund_requests WHERE shopping_mall_refund_requests.orderId = shopping_mall_orders.id AND status = 'approved'). Counts orders with at least one approved refund request.

totalCustomers.description: Total number of customer accounts registered on the platform, excluding banned accounts.
totalCustomers.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopping_mall_customers WHERE isBanned = false. Counts all non-banned customer accounts registered on the platform.

pendingCancellations.description: Number of cancellation requests submitted by customers that are still pending approval from sellers or administrators.
pendingCancellations.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopping_mall_cancellation_requests WHERE status = 'pending'. Counts cancellation requests awaiting seller or administrator response.

pendingRefunds.description: Number of refund requests submitted by customers that are still pending approval from sellers or administrators.
pendingRefunds.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopping_mall_refund_requests WHERE status = 'pending'. Counts refund requests awaiting seller or administrator response.

activeSessions.description: Total number of active user sessions (customer, seller, admin, super admin) with valid, unexpired JWT tokens.
activeSessions.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopping_mall_customer_sessions WHERE expiresAt > NOW() UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopping_mall_admin_sessions WHERE expiresAt > NOW() UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopping_mall_seller_sessions WHERE expiresAt > NOW() UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopping_mall_super_admin_sessions WHERE expiresAt > NOW(). systemUptimeHours.description: Continuous uptime of the platform system since the last restart, measured in full hours. Indicates system stability and reliability.

averageOrderValue.description: Average monetary value of completed and paid orders on the platform. Indicates overall customer spending patterns.

customerRetentionRate.description: Percentage of customers who have placed more than one order within the last 90 days, indicating user retention and platform loyalty.

IShoppingMallSalePromotion.description: Individual metric record for a promotional effectiveness analytics report, representing the aggregated performance of a single promotional campaign. IShoppingMallSalePromotion.x-autobe-specification: This is a computed schema representing a single row of promotional effectiveness analytics, calculated by joining ShoppingMallSales with ShoppingMallSalePromotions and ShoppingMallOrderItems tables. The metrics are aggregated per promotionId as follows: revenue = SUM(order_item.price * order_item.quantity), discountRate = AVG(promotion.discount_percentage), uniqueCustomers = COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id), unitsSold = SUM(order_item.quantity), conversionRate = (COUNT(DISTINCT sales_with_promotion) / COUNT(total_product_views) * 100). The promotionName and promotionType come from the ShoppingMallSalePromotions table. This is a read-only analytics type with no database direct mapping.

IShoppingMallAdminPasswordReset.x-autobe-specification: This DTO represents an administrator application request record stored in the shopping_mall_admin_requests table. It is a transient tracking entity generated when a customer or seller submits an admin application. The record is created by client code using adminRequestId, requestedAt, and userId from the authenticated session, with status pre-set to 'pending' and reason from the request body. External system services update status to 'approved' or 'rejected' after super-admin review. This model does not represent a core business entity with direct CRUD operations but serves as an immutable audit trail for access control decisions. All fields are required and immutable after creation.

customer_count.x-autobe-specification: Derived metric from shopping_mall_sale_view_stats: COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) derived from the relationship between shopping_mall_sale_id and customer sessions or orders for the authenticated seller's account. Represents unique customers who made purchases.

total_units_sold.description: Total number of product units sold across all completed orders in the seller's shop.
total_units_sold.x-autobe-specification: Derived metric from shopping_mall_sale_view_stats: SUM of unit quantities extracted from sale details for the authenticated seller's account, representing total items sold across all orders.

average_order_value.description: Average amount spent per completed order, calculated as total revenue divided by total number of orders.
average_order_value.x-autobe-specification: Derived metric from shopping_mall_sale_view_stats: revenue / total_orders. Uses pre-aggregated values from shopping_mall_sale_view_stats to compute average order value across all completed orders, where revenue is SUM(sale) and total_orders is COUNT(DISTINCT order_id).

customer_retention_rate.description: Percentage of customers who have made more than one purchase from this seller's shop, indicating customer loyalty.
customer_retention_rate.x-autobe-specification: Derived metric from shopping_mall_sale_view_stats: (customers with multiple orders / customer_count) * 100. Calculated by identifying customers with multiple shopping_mall_sale_id entries (mapped to customer_id) and dividing by total unique customer_count.

IShoppingMallSaleSnapshot.description:
Contains aggregated performance summary metrics for the seller's shop on the shoppingMall platform.

This summary provides key business indicators for a seller's shop performance including total sales volume, revenue generated, number of orders processed, average order value, unique customer count, customer retention rate (percentage of customers who made multiple purchases), and total units sold across all products in the seller's shop.

All metrics are computed from immutable order snapshots that preserve the exact state of products, variants, seller profiles, and pricing at the moment of purchase, ensuring historical accuracy. The calculation excludes any products or variants that have been deleted by the seller after the order was placed.

The revenue figure includes only completed payments and excludes refunds or cancellations. The average order value and number of customers represent unique customers who completed any purchase from the seller's shop. Customer retention is calculated based on repeat purchase behavior, defined as customers making more than one purchase.

This information is used by sellers to understand their shop's performance, identify trends, and make informed business decisions.
IShoppingMallSaleSnapshot.x-autobe-specification: Source: Aggregates data from shopping_mall_sale_view_stats table for the authenticated seller. Computes all metrics using the available columns: id, shopping_mall_sale_id, and sale. The aggregation logic must be implemented through server-side computations using the schema's available fields, with seller_id from authentication context. All calculations exclude deleted products/variants. Since the schema does not expose direct columns for sales_count, total_revenue, order_count, unique_customer_count, or unit_quantity, these are computed metrics aggregated from available data.

status.description: The status of the administrative action, which is always 'rejected' for this response type.
status.x-autobe-specification: Fixed constant value 'rejected' indicating the seller application has been formally denied by an administrator. This value is set programmatically and never changes.

timestamp.description: The precise timestamp when the seller application was rejected, in ISO 8601 format (UTC).
timestamp.x-autobe-specification: Server-generated ISO 8601 timestamp (UTC) capturing the exact time when the rejection action was processed by the system. This is not a database field but a system-generated audit time.

IShoppingMallDeliveryConfirmation.description: Confirmation message returned after an administrator successfully rejects a seller application. Contains the fixed status 'rejected' and server-generated timestamp to acknowledge the administrative action has been processed.
IShoppingMallDeliveryConfirmation.x-autobe-specification: Response DTO for admin rejection of seller application. Returns fixed status 'rejected' and server-generated timestamp. This is a simple acknowledgment type that does not map to any database table, but is constructed in-memory upon successful completion of the rejection operation.

totalSales.description: Total sales amount generated from all completed orders in the current month.
totalSales.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. SUM of order totals from shopping_mall_orders table for current month.

averageOrderValue.description: Average value of all completed orders in the current month.
averageOrderValue.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. AVG of order totals from shopping_mall_orders table for current month.

inventoryTurnoverRate.description: The number of times inventory is sold and replaced over a monthly period. Measures inventory efficiency and turnover speed.
inventoryTurnoverRate.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. Calculated as (total cost of goods sold / average inventory value). COGS sourced from shopping_mall_orders based on product variant prices, average inventory value from shopping_mall_inventory_records. Time period is current month.

conversionRate.description: The percentage of product views that result in completed purchases. Measures effectiveness of product presentation and customer intent.
conversionRate.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. Division: number of completed purchases (from shopping_mall_orders) divided by total product views (from shopping_mall_sale_view_stats). Ratio expressed as decimal (0 to 1).

customerRetentionRate.description: The percentage of customers who made more than one purchase within the current reporting period. Measures customer loyalty and platform stickiness.
customerRetentionRate.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. Percentage of customers who made repeat purchases within the current month. Calculated as: (unique customers with >1 order) / (total unique customers who made purchases) * 100.

topProducts.description: The 10 best-performing products in terms of total sales volume during the current month. Each entry contains product information and total sales count.
topProducts.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. Top 10 products by total sales volume (quantity * unit price) across shopping_mall_orders and shopping_mall_order_items tables. Each item includes productId and total sales count.

bottomProducts.description: The 10 worst-performing products in terms of total sales volume during the current month. Each entry contains product information and total sales count.
bottomProducts.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation. Bottom 10 products by total sales volume (quantity * unit price) across shopping_mall_orders and shopping_mall_order_items tables. Each item includes productId and total sales count.

IShoppingMallSale.description: Comprehensive sales performance metrics for the shoppingMall platform. Contains key business KPIs for admin decision-making, including total sales, average order value, inventory turnover rate, conversion rate from product views to purchases, customer retention rate, and lists of top and bottom performing products.
IShoppingMallSale.x-autobe-specification: This is a computed/aggregated response type for sales performance metrics. Data sourced from: totalSales from SUM of order values in shopping_mall_orders; averageOrderValue from AVG of order totals; inventoryTurnoverRate from (total cost of goods sold / average inventory value), where cost of goods sold is from shopping_mall_orders and inventory value is from shopping_mall_inventory_records; conversionRate from (number of completed purchases / number of product views) using shopping_mall_sale_view_stats; customerRetentionRate from percentage of customers who made repeat purchases within the time period; topProducts from top 10 products by sales volume across shopping_mall_orders and shopping_mall_order_items; bottomProducts from bottom 10 products by sales volume across the same tables. Calculations use time period of current month. All values are zero or positive. When no data, numeric values should be 0. topProducts and bottomProducts should be arrays of objects with at least productId and salesCount.

imageId.x-autobe-specification: References image_id from shopping_mall_product_images table via foreign key relationship. Value used for lookup and validation against existing product images in the system.

IShoppingMallProductImage.IReorderItem.description: An individual instruction to reorder a specific product image by its unique identifier to a new position in the sequence. Represents one item in the image ordering array of the reorder operation.
IShoppingMallProductImage.IReorderItem.x-autobe-specification: Transient request DTO used exclusively in PUT /products/{productId}/images/reorder endpoint to specify reordering instructions for product images. This is not a persistent entity - represents a client-side instruction for changing image display order. The entire array is sent as JSON body and processed as atomic operation with no individual persistence.

status.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation: Derived from order_items status. If all order_items are 'delivered': 'delivered'; if any order_items are 'refunded': 'refunded'; if any order_items are 'cancelled': 'cancelled'; if all order_items are 'paid' and at least one is 'shipped': 'shipped'; if all order_items are 'paid' and none shipped: 'paid'; if any order_items are 'shipped' and some 'delivered' and some not: 'partially_completed'.
status.description: Current lifecycle status of the order: 'paid' (completed payment), 'shipped' (items dispatched), 'delivered' (fulfilled and received), 'cancelled' (request processed), 'refunded' (payment returned), or 'partially_completed' (some items delivered but others still pending). Can be null if status is not yet determined.

id.description: Unique identifier for the order in the system, represented as a UUID.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_orders.id column. UUID primary key for order identification.

orderNumber.description: Unique alphanumeric order number in format 'ORD-YYYYMMDD-NNNN' for customer reference and transaction tracking.
orderNumber.x-autobe-specification: Computed field: Concatenates 'ORD-' prefix with the 8-digit formatted creation date from shopping_mall_orders.created_at and a zero-padded 4-digit sequence number derived from the order's id hash. Format: 'ORD-YYYYMMDD-NNNN'.

totalPrice.description: Total monetary value of the entire order in the base currency at the time of purchase, including items, taxes, and discounts.
totalPrice.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation: SUM of (order_items.price * order_items.quantity) from all order_items associated with this order, where order_items.order_id = shopping_mall_orders.id. Includes taxes and discounts applied to each order item.

IShoppingMallOrder.ISummary.description: Lightweight summary representation of an order for display in list views such as customer order history. Contains essential information for browsing: unique identifier, order number, total price, current status, and creation timestamp. Excludes detailed order items, shipping addresses, and shipment information for optimal performance in list contexts.
IShoppingMallOrder.ISummary.x-autobe-specification: Summary DTO for shopping_mall_orders table. This DTO provides a lightweight representation of an order for list displays, excluding detailed items and shipping information for performance optimization in UI contexts. The orderNumber, totalPrice, status, and createdAt fields are computed: orderNumber is formatted from order ID and creation time, totalPrice is aggregated from order_items, status is derived from order_items item statuses, and createdAt is read directly from the database. Only 'id' is a direct mapping from the database.

access.description:
Short-lived JWT access token for authenticating API requests.

This token must be included in the Authorization header using the Bearer
scheme (e.g., `Authorization: Bearer {access}`) for all endpoints requiring
authentication. The token contains encoded claims including user identity,
roles, and permissions. Typically expires within 15-60 minutes for
security; use the refresh token to obtain a new access token when expired.
access.x-autobe-specification: JWT access token. Use in Authorization header as "Bearer {access}".

refresh.description:
Long-lived refresh token for obtaining new access tokens.

Used to request new access tokens when the current access token expires,
allowing session continuation without re-authentication. Should be stored
securely and transmitted only to the token refresh endpoint. Typical
lifetime ranges from 7 to 30 days depending on security requirements.
refresh.x-autobe-specification: Refresh token for obtaining new access tokens without re-authentication.

expired_at.description:
ISO 8601 timestamp when the access token expires.

After this timestamp, the access token will be rejected by authenticated
endpoints. Clients should proactively refresh before expiration to maintain
seamless user experience. A common strategy is to refresh when remaining
time falls below 5 minutes. This timestamp is also embedded within the JWT
itself as the "exp" claim.
expired_at.x-autobe-specification: Access token expiration timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

refreshable_until.description:
ISO 8601 timestamp indicating the absolute session expiration deadline.

Represents the latest possible time the refresh token can be used. Once
this timestamp is reached, the user must fully re-authenticate with
credentials. This defines the maximum session duration regardless of
activity. If refresh token rotation is enabled, this deadline may extend
with each successful refresh.
refreshable_until.x-autobe-specification: Refresh token expiration timestamp. Re-authentication required after this time.

IShoppingMallAuthorizationToken.description:
JWT-based authorization token pair with expiration metadata.

Provides a complete authentication token structure containing both access and
refresh tokens along with their respective expiration timestamps. This
dual-token pattern enables secure, stateless authentication with automatic
session renewal capabilities.

The access token is short-lived for security, while the refresh token allows
obtaining new access tokens without requiring the user to re-enter
credentials. This structure is automatically included in authentication
responses across all generated backend applications.
IShoppingMallAuthorizationToken.x-autobe-specification: Dual-token authentication structure with access/refresh tokens and expiration info.

IShoppingMallCustomerAddress.description: Immutable shipping address snapshot captured at time of order placement. Contains all mandatory components for delivery: recipient name, complete street address, city, postal code, and country. Optional fields include state/province for tax/shipping calculations and phone number for delivery notifications. The isDefault flag indicates whether this was the customer's default address at the time of order creation, preserved for historical context only.
IShoppingMallCustomerAddress.x-autobe-specification: Embedded JSON structure stored directly in the shopping_mall_orders.shippingAddress column. This immutable snapshot captures the complete customer shipping address state (recipientName, streetAddress, city, stateProvince, postalCode, country, phoneNumber, isDefault) at the moment of order placement. All address components are stored as a single JSON object to preserve historical integrity and prevent changes to customer profiles from altering past order records. The entire object is stored verbatim from the customer's checkout submission without normalization or component-level separation in the database.
